$comment: Post-B5 evidence manifest, schema version 1 — patch 438, ADR-0003 §12.193. THE VALIDATOR IS scripts/evidence-manifest.py AND IT IS THE AUTHORITY; this file is the human-readable statement of the same shape, kept beside the manifests it describes. A field here that the validator does not check is a field nobody checks.

required.schemaVersion: integer — must be a version the validator knows. A manifest from another version is NOT machine-evaluable here and is refused rather than half-read.
required.id: kebab-case slug, and it must equal the filename stem. Predecessors are cited by this id.
required.task: the runbook task this closes, e.g. "0A".
required.title: one line, for a human reading a directory listing.
required.status: draft | accepted | blocked. Later tasks key off "accepted", so it is the one word that may not be self-asserted.
required.owner: who is answerable for the record.
required.approval: object or null. REQUIRED non-null when status is "accepted": {by, atUTC, statement}, and "by" must equal "owner". Must be null otherwise.
required.predecessors: list of {id, sha256}. The sha256 is the hash of THAT MANIFEST FILE, which is what makes a predecessor revised underneath this one a detectable fact rather than a silent one.
required.tree: {commit, patch, digest} — the implementation tree the evidence was taken against. "digest" is scripts/evidence-manifest.py digest: sorted (path, content hash) over Sub4/, Sub4CoreTests/ and scripts/. Recomputed only when HEAD is the named commit; otherwise the validator SAYS it did not recompute, and --require-recompute makes that a failure.
required.binding: {commit, signature:{kind, value}} — the final commit and the external signature binding this record to it. binding.commit must equal tree.commit.
required.evidence: non-empty list of {path, sha256, bytes}. Paths are relative to the manifest's own directory and may not be absolute or climb out of it. A missing file and a changed file are reported as different answers — MISSING and STALE.

refusals: unknown or missing key — checked in both directions, because a fact nobody reads and a fact nobody stated are the same defect from either end
status accepted with no approval, or an approval signed by somebody who is not the owner
a predecessor id nobody supplied (MISSING) or whose file has changed since it was cited (STALE)
a circular predecessor chain, reported against every manifest on the cycle
an evidence file that is absent (MISSING) or whose hash or size has moved (STALE)
binding.commit naming a different commit from tree.commit
an empty evidence list — a manifest citing nothing proves nothing
no manifests given at all: that is not a pass, it is exit 2
